name: TC-1827
summary: TC-1827 is an orally active, selective agonist of the α4β2 nicotinic receptors. Administration of TC-1827 improved memory and learning in a variety of rodents and increased long-term potentiation in hippocampal slices. In addition, the compound was without significant cardiovascular side effects, except for a small, transient rise in arterial blood pressure.0 hours) would suggest.

pharmacology.text: TC-1827 is an orally active, selective agonist of the α4β2 nicotinic receptors. Administration of TC-1827 improved memory and learning in a variety of rodents and increased long-term potentiation in hippocampal slices.

summaryZh: TC-1827是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C10H15N3，帶有一個嘧啶基團，可作為α4β2菸鹼型乙醯膽鹼受體的選擇性激動劑。
summaryZhHans: TC-1827是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C10H15N3，带有一个嘧啶基团，可作为α4β2烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体的选择性激动剂。

uses.en: It is a research compound studied in rodents as a possible enhancer of memory and learning.
uses.zh: 它是一種研究用化合物，曾在囓齒動物身上研究作為可能的記憶與學習增強劑。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种研究用化合物，曾在囓齿动物身上研究作为可能的记忆与学习增强剂。

fact.en: The TC prefix comes from Targacept, a company spun out of the tobacco firm R.J. Reynolds to turn nicotine research into medicines.
fact.zh: TC字首來自Targacept公司，這家公司由菸草企業雷諾菸草公司分拆而出，目標是把尼古丁研究轉化為藥物。
fact.zhHans: TC前缀来自Targacept公司，这家公司由烟草企业雷诺烟草公司分拆而出，目标是把尼古丁研究转化为药物。
